==== generated/enforced.d/one/hello.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GENERATED FILE, do not edit.
set -euxo pipefail

MODDIR=/ctx/modules/one/hello
export MODDIR

export ASSET_HELLO_VERSION="1.4.0"
export ASSET_HELLO_URL="https://github.com/owner/hello/releases/download/v1.4.0/hello.tar.gz"
export ASSET_HELLO_SHA256="b7c232b0e8249d8e55a40beb79c5c43a7d370f3f9408bd215deb0170daeaadf3"

if [ -f /etc/yum.repos.d/hello.repo ]; then
    echo "repo hello is already configured"
else
    source /ctx/modules/one/hello/repo
fi

source /ctx/modules/one/hello/module.sh

==== generated/enforced.graph.md
# Enforced capability graph

GENERATED FILE, do not edit.

An arrow points from a provider to what needs it, dotted for `after`,
which orders the build without requiring anything. Layers build left to
right.

```mermaid
graph LR
    base["quay.io/fedora/fedora-bootc:44"]
    m0["one/hello"]
    m1["core/consumer"]
    m0 -->|"hello"| m1
```

## Capabilities

| Name | Kind | Provided by | Required by | After |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hello` | capability | `one/hello` | `core/consumer` |  |
| `rechunking` | capability | `base` |  |  |
